say:2:1421105001:1.text: Poetry and songs are the kind of stuff that nobles fancy. I don't have time for that.
say:2:1421105001:1.source_cn: 那都是贵族老爷喜欢的东西吧，什么诗啊歌啊的，我可没空听那个。

say:3:1421105002:1.text: Um, may I ask why you don't like poetry?
say:3:1421105002:1.source_cn: 啊，请问，您是为什么不喜欢诗歌呢？

say:4:1421105003:1.text: The phrases are simply too complicated to understand. And when I finally do, it turns out to be nothing but nonsense.
say:4:1421105003:1.source_cn: 就……首先词儿就很复杂，我听不明白，好不容易明白意思，...

say:5:1421105004:1.text: There's this line that goes, "A solitary rose blooms in a deserted corner, hit by the rain, aching in silence..."
say:5:1421105004:1.source_cn: 什么无人的地方一朵独自绽放的玫瑰，被雨滴打湿的疼痛，破...

say:6:1421105005:1.text: I thought it was about a murdered gardener, but my friend told me it actually described a young woman's secret crush!
say:6:1421105005:1.source_cn: 我还以为是讲种花的园丁让人给杀了，结果我朋友告诉我说那...

say:7:1421105006:1.text: Ah, I get it. I should use simpler wording and avoid excessive metaphors...
say:7:1421105006:1.source_cn: 唔唔，明白了，用词都要更简白易懂，不要太多描写……

say:8:1421105007:1.text: Love stories are fine and all, but I'd rather hear something more exciting!
say:8:1421105007:1.source_cn: 而且啊，也不是说不能谈情说爱，但都花时间听唱歌了，我想...

say:9:1421105008:1.text: Like legends and adventures—especially if they are true stories! I want something that keeps me on the edge of my seat!
say:9:1421105008:1.source_cn: 比如传奇啊，冒险啊，如果有真实背景的，热血沸腾的，让人...
